name: void-book-sample-v2
description: Local Void task sample with pstack and reproducible quality gates

scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run quality && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
scripts.quality:complexity: node scripts/run-quality-tool.mjs cccc src pages routes db --config cccc.toml
scripts.quality:similarity: node scripts/run-quality-tool.mjs similarity-ts src pages routes db --exclude src/components/ui --exclude "*.test.ts" --threshold 0.9 --min-lines 8 --fail-on-duplicates
scripts.quality: npm run quality:unused && npm run quality:complexity && npm run quality:similarity
scripts.ci:headless: npm run check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run quality && npm run build && npm run test:integration
